trigger: Global equity rout following US reciprocal tariffs
magnitude: Extreme negative: US equities lost about USD 2.4 trillion in value on 3 Apr.
reason: A sharp downgrade to global growth / trade expectations can depress Indian exporters and trigger portfolio de-risking. China's later 4 Apr retaliation excluded.
timing: 4 Apr 07:30 IST report documents completed 3 Apr US selloff; initial tariff announcement early 3 Apr IST.

trigger: Global trade-war panic and fresh Monday Asian selloff
magnitude: Extreme negative sentiment: Nikkei hit downside limit; GIFT near 22,167.5.
reason: Escalating tariff/recession fears can produce indiscriminate risk reduction and large opening losses. China's 34% retaliation from Friday is older background; Monday Asian cascade is fresh evidence.
timing: 7 Apr premarket guide and 07:47 IST First Tick; Friday retaliation labelled background.

trigger: Asian rebound after severe selloff despite further tariff threats
magnitude: High positive rebound signal: GIFT about +386 points; negative offset of threatened additional 50% China tariff.
reason: Regional relief and oversold positioning can support Indian rebound, but no confirmed tariff pause existed at cutoff; the 7 Apr pause rumour was denied.
timing: Mint overnight digest published 8 Apr 2025 07:13 IST; Asian rebound and GIFT quote verified before cutoff. No confirmed tariff pause existed then.

trigger: US-China tariff escalation to 104%; overnight stocks lower
magnitude: High negative: US stated total China duty 104%; early Asia down around 3%.
reason: Trade-war escalation raises recession and EM risk; consistent with decline. RBI 25bp cut and accommodative stance announced later that morning excluded.
timing: Upstox publication 9 Apr 08:20 IST (headline incorrectly says Apr 8); overnight escalation eligible. RBI outcome after cutoff excluded.

trigger: 90-day reciprocal-tariff pause available after Indian holiday
magnitude: High positive relief vs 9 Apr close; negative offset from US pullback / 145% China duty.
reason: Pause reduces immediate tariff damage for India and encourages relief buying after holiday. Conflicting overnight markets and TCS earnings limit attribution.
timing: Pause announced 9 Apr US afternoon = early 10 Apr IST, within prior-calendar-day window; Moneycontrol 11 Apr 08:53 IST shows conflicting negative cues.

trigger: US tech rebound after electronics tariff exemptions
magnitude: High/moderate positive relief; overnight technology-led US gains.
reason: Exemptions ease immediate supply-chain disruption fears and lift global risk appetite. Original weekend exemption is older background; 14 Apr market response is eligible.
timing: 15 Apr First Tick 07:52 IST; 14 Apr US rally falls in window. Indian market closed 14 Apr.

trigger: Prior-day foreign buying opposed weak US stocks / Wipro guidance
magnitude: High mixed: 16 Apr FPI +INR 3,936.42 crore; Nasdaq -3.07%; GIFT -104 at 07:34.
reason: Foreign buying can support banks/large caps while US technology weakness hurts IT. Mixed cues cannot fully explain positive 1.768% close; later buying excluded.
timing: Ventura gives 17 Apr 07:34 IST quote. Later BS report corroborates 16 Apr flows only; its conflicting early-trade quote not relied on.

trigger: Strong private-bank earnings background and trade-talk hopes
magnitude: Moderate positive; ICICI earnings beat estimates.
reason: Bank profitability can lift NIFTY through large financial weights. HDFC/ICICI results released Saturday 19 Apr are outside strict Sunday window; exact new Sunday development not established.
timing: 19 Apr bank results treated as older background; 21 Apr morning digest mentions trade talks, exact release time unverified.
status: B04 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger

trigger: Trump eased Powell-dismissal fears; US-China de-escalation hopes
magnitude: High positive risk relief: GIFT approximately +202 points; overnight Wall Street rally.
reason: Lower Fed-independence and tariff risks can reduce global risk premia. Pahalgam attack on 22 Apr is a serious competing negative; positive close cannot be attributed to that attack.
timing: 23 Apr 07:20 IST article; 22 Apr US comments/market session eligible.

trigger: Pakistan closed airspace to Indian airlines and rejected water-treaty suspension; geopolitical escalation
magnitude: High negative diplomatic escalation; positive US tech cues and GIFT about +154 points offset.
reason: Airspace restrictions increase airline operating costs while broader diplomatic retaliation raises country risk. Positive global cues limit confidence in explaining the whole negative close. Overnight border-firing report lacks a verified pre-09:00 publication time and is not accepted as the qualifying trigger.
timing: Reuters report published 24 Apr 2025 16:45 IST establishes prior-day airspace/treaty escalation. Border-firing report updated after cutoff is excluded from accepted evidence.

trigger: Easing trade concerns and positive premarket risk appetite
reason: Improved tariff expectations can support large caps and exporters; foreign inflow streak is older background. No confirmed new Sunday trade agreement established.
timing: 28 Apr 07:55 IST article quotes 07:30 GIFT; Friday US rally and FII purchases labelled background.

trigger: Escalation / retaliation risk following Operation Sindoor; Fed hold
magnitude: High geopolitical negative; Fed left rates unchanged, GIFT about -41 points.
reason: Military conflict risk raises Indian risk premia; Fed caution on growth/inflation limits global support. Later 8 May attacks cannot be assumed known in morning.
timing: Mint overnight digest published 8 May 2025 07:01 IST; Fed decision and 7 May conflict developments already public. Later 8 May attacks excluded.

magnitude: High negative military escalation, despite supportive US-UK trade news.
reason: Potential wider conflict raises country and earnings risk and encourages portfolio reduction; direct local shock is more pertinent than positive overseas equities.
timing: Additional check: FE live report contains 9 May 07:45 / 07:56 IST entries covering India-Pakistan tensions before open. Night 8-9 May attacks are distinct from later event-session news.

trigger: India-Pakistan ceasefire relief and Sunday follow-up
magnitude: High positive de-escalation; Saturday 17:00 ceasefire; GIFT 24,552.5 at 08:12 Monday.
reason: Reduced immediate war risk can reverse risk premia / short positions. Saturday agreement is background; Sunday hotline/update is eligible continuing information. US-China tariff deal announced later Monday is excluded.
timing: Reuters morning report quotes 12 May 08:12 IST and Sunday ceasefire-violation hotline message; original agreement 10 May outside strict prior-day window.

trigger: US-China tariff truce positive; domestic rebound vulnerable to reversal
magnitude: High positive global news but mixed domestic signal: 90-day truce; GIFT -128 points after NIFTY +3.818%.
reason: Tariff de-escalation supports growth/risk appetite; negative close may reflect position unwinding after outsized rally. Profit taking is an inference, not an external shock.
timing: 13 May 07:11 IST; US-China agreement announced 12 May, eligible. Event-session flows excluded.

trigger: Mixed overnight equities; no verified pre-09:00 major positive shock
magnitude: Low/moderate positive carryover: S&P third straight gain, Asian markets softer.
reason: Ongoing trade relief may support sentiment, but the large afternoon rally followed Trump's India tariff comments after cutoff. Those cannot be used as a qualifying morning trigger.
timing: Mint 15 May 07:04 IST supports mixed cues. Later Indian Express explicitly locates Trump-related rally in afternoon; excluded.
